name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: Fixes a real playback blocker found while testing 0.0.37 live: federated items on a Direct-mode server with WAN bitrate capping enabled (WanCapMode Auto or Manual) had no Play button at all on their own detail page. Root cause: ResolvePlaybackUrl deliberately left item.Path null for those items to avoid freezing a URL that could go stale once the bandwidth classification/measurement changes later. But with Path null, Jellyfin's own static media source comes back as MediaSourceType.Placeholder - literally 'no media here' - and the item-detail endpoint embeds that static source rather than calling this plugin's dynamic provider, so jellyfin-web's Details page saw a Placeholder and never rendered a Play button, regardless of the fully valid, correctly-capped source this plugin's own FederationMediaSourceProvider was already supplying through PlaybackInfo. item.Path is now always stamped (Container set to mp4 to match the forced h264/aac encode when capped, instead of the source file's real container). The staleness this was originally guarding against is already handled elsewhere: when a later bandwidth decision makes the stored Path stale, GetMediaSources already detects the mismatch and serves a corrected alternate source alongside it - worst case a wrong bitrate until that self-heals, not an unplayable item. No config or data migration; existing servers, mappings, and watch progress are untouched.
